modules.towers.description: يهاجم قلاع اللصوص النبلاء في كل مملكة، بالقادة الذين تسمح بهم. لكل مملكة مفتاحها وإعداداتها الخاصة.

plugins.commanderPicker.mapped: This account has a commander map, so the bot does not read this list. The map decides which commanders these attacks send.
plugins.commanderMap.intro: While any commander is assigned, only assigned commanders are sent out. A plugin sends its own commanders first, then its group’s, and a plugin with none sends nothing. Auto Station is the exception: with none assigned it keeps its own commander list, so it can still move troops out. With no commander assigned at all, every plugin keeps its own commander list.
plugins.commanderMap.tilesHelp: Or click a commander to give it to the owner picked above ({{owner}}). Click it again to take it away. Commanders with an owner are underlined.
plugins.commanderMap.starved: On with no commanders, so it sends nothing
